column4: dialect-gated: the test checks that an error from the statement a SQL Server scoped read folds after its read reaches the caller through Scan, which exists only on SQL Server, and gets its database from testutil.TestDB, which skips when CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL is unset (cleat#3678). test-go/commands runs cmd/cleat-worker with only the PostgreSQL DSN, so it skips whole there: 1 skip, measured 2026-11-12 by running it with only CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES set and reading the skip name.
